title: Past Stories, Time and Memories
overview: A lesson-based homework on Past Simple, Past Continuous, time prepositions, used to, narrative vocabulary and story-writing.
sections: Past Simple: affirmative, negative and question forms
Time prepositions: in, on and at
Used to for changed past habits and states
Vocabulary for stories, sequence, school and personality
Reading, external listening, writing and a 50-question final quiz
